verdict.rationale: Ledgy documents a programmatic API with a `companyCaptable` operation that returns a company's cap table data. Access uses OAuth 2.0 client_credentials tokens issued to per-integration service accounts. Results can be paged and limited to rows changed since an earlier request, so an agent can pull current cap table data and feed it into an external reconciliation. Missing for 10: no API access to attached transaction documents or any data-room integration for the reconciliation side, no machine-readable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt for agent discovery (probes returned 404), and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
